notes.title: Veranoia 1.9
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778326/3f754de372acf57773e7f20b6088e7a690ae69ec.png[/img]

Update Announcement – New Features and Improvements

We are excited to announce the latest update for our game, which includes new content, performance improvements, and optimizations. Here are the details:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778326/8c0c1c7c1bbb0266244b1d0a7c92973e3fed082f.png[/img]
New ICP Hospital Chapter
A brand-new chapter has been added to enrich the story and gameplay experience:

Expanded Storyline: Learn more about the protagonist’s background and discover key details that enhance the overall story.
Clearer Objectives: This chapter makes your goals and tasks more straightforward and easier to follow.
Interactive NPCs: Meet new non-playable characters who add depth and interaction to the game.
Game Performance Improvements
We have made several changes to enhance the game’s performance and visuals:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778326/3899e5f32002d40935eb361d7cbc6a94369ba44f.png[/img]
Optimized Textures: High-resolution 8K textures are now limited to important elements, improving performance while keeping visuals sharp.
Better Draw Distance: Objects now appear from farther away, making the game world feel larger and more realistic.
Improved Lighting: The lighting system has been upgraded to create a more immersive and visually appealing environment.
Game Size Optimization
We have worked hard to reduce the game’s size while maintaining its quality:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778326/95cb6fe9d37753063ff8f4f2c231ad1f31d32432.png[/img]
Unused Textures Removed: Unnecessary and high-resource textures have been removed to free up space.
Smaller File Size: The game size has been reduced from 6 GB to just 900 MB, making it easier to download and store.
This update brings new content and significant improvements to make the game more enjoyable and accessible. Thank you for your support, and we look forward to hearing your feedback. Stay tuned for more updates soon!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778326/39e84aae82dc45b41e8cbad3062fbd9ce523eb48.png[/img]
Let me know if you need further adjustments!

notes.title: Veranoia 1.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778326/8e457e282e9f05739f07e1bfd1b5af3836c83e75.png[/img]
Happy to Announce a Major Update which includes:
* Story/Explanations Improvements
* New More Story Characters (Enemies, Friendlies) Aimed to dive deeper into the story
* More Items (Red Pill, Ancient Talisman, Trinket, and More)
* Clearer Objectives Aimed to dive deeper into the story
* New Heartbeat / Fear System
* New Chasing Systems
* More Deadly events added
* Some unnecessary jumpscares were removed
* The story script revised, fully rewritted, made clearer
* Lighting system have been revised
* Unveiling more secrets of the eye syndicate's real life wing (IPC)
* Map/Level Design Adjusments/Improvements

* Game Price Revised (1.99$)


This update took about 5 months, Hope you like it, 
And More is Available In Game!! <3 =)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44778326/3f47cff7269be59d39d44f03c8a23653f53310ed.png[/img]
